Web · Wisconsin Creative

Snow Leopard high-traffic polish

A bug-fix and quality-of-life pass across Dashboard, Schedule, Bookings, Items, Settings, and app chrome. Status copy is sentence case, high-traffic actions keep 40px targets, and recovery paths name the actual work.

After-only authenticated Preview

No matched before/after pair. The working tree already contained unrelated chrome, settings, and schedule work, so HEAD is not a trustworthy baseline. Captures are ADMIN, dark appearance, authenticated local Preview at 127.0.0.1:3000.

What changed, and why

Pending pickup goes to checkouts

Was

Dashboard pending-pickup links opened the reservations tab.

Now

Pending pickup opens /bookings?tab=checkouts&status=PENDING_PICKUP.

Sync does not look live before it is

Was

Idle label was Sync starting with an always-on green glow.

Now

Initial label is Checking sync. Green glow applies only while state is active.

Sentence-case status and role

Was

Detail badges and search used title case; sidebar CSS uppercased Admin to ADMIN.

Now

Checked out, Pending pickup, and Maintenance match the list language. Role caption is Admin without an uppercase class.

Settings ⌘K is one palette

Was

Global search and settings search both handled Meta+K.

Now

AppShell skips /settings. SettingsCommand captures the shortcut. CommandDialog hides the overlapping Close control.

Empty and recovery copy names the work

Was

All-tab empty said active all bookings. Week empty told people to leave today. Settings search had no Clear.

Now

All tab says bookings. This week empty stays on this week. Settings empty has Clear search.

Verification

  • Focused vitest: 9 files / 82 tests pass (dashboard pending-pickup, status labels, decision contracts, sidebar, settings polish, pending-action, operational loading, dashboard motion, booking realtime, dashboard stats/fast-count, settings sweeping, status-color, schedule review/timeline).
  • npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false: pass
  • git diff --check on touched polish files: pass
  • npm run build:app: skipped. Preview already owns 127.0.0.1:3000.
  • Authenticated Preview as Erik Role ADMIN, dark: Dashboard, Bookings All, Items, Schedule, Settings directory. Settings search aria-label matches placeholder. Notifications (20 unread) is the accessible name. Shift rows expose Open {event} links. Checking sync has no green glow.
  • Dashboard error boundary fired once after a debug useEffect was inserted after early returns (Rules of Hooks). Moved the log above those returns and Retry restored the page.
  • Schedule list was still skeleton in the after capture; ListView nested-control and week-empty copy are locked in source. Items after capture was also still loading rows.
  • Debug instrumentation remains in AppShell, SettingsCommand, and dashboard page until this pass is confirmed.

Things to know

  • After-only because the checkout already contained unrelated dirty work; do not treat HEAD as the pre-change baseline.
  • The Next.js issue overlay in some captures is Cursor-browser hydration (data-cursor-ref) plus HMR, not product chrome.
  • Do not run npm run build while Preview occupies :3000.
  • Unrelated dirty work (schedule activity feed, user profile, auto-assign, archived proofs) was left in place.
